title: A Love Letter to the Valley: Inside the San Fernando Valley’s 818 Day Festival
description:
Valley pride took center stage as Winnetka celebrated 818 Day at Cupid’s Hot Dogs. Bringing together live music, local artisans, and community nonprofits, the event showcased the deep-rooted pride and history of the West San Fernando Valley.

For 80 years, Cupid’s Hot Dogs has been a beloved third-generation family institution, serving classic eats while preserving its original atmosphere. Beyond the festivities, the day underscored a vital message: supporting historic mom-and-pop businesses is essential to keeping local neighborhoods healthy, resilient, and thriving.

With great music, delicious local food, and family fun, this year's 818 Day proved that Valley pride is stronger than ever.
